name: Item Enchantment Template
description: Random enchantment rolls: when an item with RandomProperty/RandomSuffix set in item_template is created, one enchantment is picked from all rows sharing the same entry, weighted by chance. Loaded by LoadRandomEnchantmentsTable (ItemEnchantmentMgr).

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Random enchantment set id, referenced by item_template.RandomProperty / RandomSuffix.

fields.name: Enchant
fields.help: ItemRandomProperties.dbc id (or ItemRandomSuffix.dbc id for suffix rolls).

fields.name: Chance
fields.help: Chance in percent (> 0 and <= 100) to roll this enchantment; rows outside this range are ignored.
